narrative.overview: The user explicitly rejected the former ivory/sage editorial design as resembling a hotel booking website. The replacement is a playable social-deduction game: charcoal panels, acid-green actions, dense arcade lettering, expressive eye avatars, and an immediate create/join/solo-play path. The old design is not visual authority.
dos: Do extend `src/game.css`, which is imported after the structural baseline in `src/styles.css`, for future UI changes.
Do keep ready/start directly below the joined-room heading on phones.
Do use photography for real clip collections and YouTube reveal thumbnails.
donts: Don't reintroduce cream surfaces, small hospitality-style entry headings, or food photography as the primary hero.
Don't reveal secret roles through actual roster art; the coral different-clip card belongs only to the labeled five-player example.
